title: CAPI Release KPIs
description: Release process KPIs, computed from merged release PRs by the Release KPIs workflow in giantswarm/releases, which embeds the data into this dashboard. The time range applies to the merge date of the release PRs. Edit tools/release-kpis/dashboard.json in that repository instead of this dashboard, the workflow overwrites it. See https://github.com/giantswarm/roadmap/issues/4382 and https://github.com/giantswarm/roadmap/issues/4385 and https://github.com/giantswarm/roadmap/issues/4398

panels.title: Merged release PRs
panels.description: All merged release PRs in the selected time range and providers. 'all green' says whether every expected E2E suite had passed or been waived before the merge; 'waived' counts the suites waived with /waive-suite. Planned merge date and delay are only set for scheduled releases; 'planned by' says whether the date was written by the create-release workflow or estimated from the creation time of an older PR. This panel holds the embedded data; the other panels read it from here.

panels.title: Median lead time: major
panels.description: Median open → merge time of merged major release PRs, in days. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median lead time: minor
panels.description: Median open → merge time of merged minor release PRs, in days. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median lead time: patch
panels.description: Median open → merge time of merged patch release PRs, in days. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median delay vs. planned date
panels.description: Scheduled releases whose planned merge date was written into the PR by the create-release workflow (since October 2026). Negative means merged before the planned date. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Merged on time
panels.description: Share of scheduled releases merged by the planned merge date the create-release workflow wrote into the PR (since October 2026). Older scheduled releases only have an estimated date and are not counted. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Lead time per release
panels.description: Open → merge time of every merged release PR, plotted at its merge date. The axis is capped at 60 days, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Delay from planned merge date
panels.description: Scheduled releases only. Negative means early. Dates written by the create-release workflow are shown in green; for older scheduled PRs the date is an estimate (the next 1st of the month after the PR was created) and is shown in grey for context only.

panels.title: Median lead time per quarter
panels.description: Median open → merge time of the releases merged in each quarter, per release type. The trend to watch. The current quarter is marked '(to date)' and still incomplete.

panels.title: Releases per quarter
panels.description: Number of release PRs merged in each quarter, per release type. Hover a bar for the total. The current quarter is marked '(to date)' and still incomplete.

options.content:
Data: all merged release PRs since CAPI v25, filtered by the time range (merge date) and the provider variable. Last updated: unknown. Use *Inspect → Data* on the table to download a CSV.

**Lead time**: PR opened → merged. **Planned merge date**: written into scheduled release PRs by the create-release workflow; older scheduled PRs only have an estimate (next 1st of the month), shown in the delay chart but not counted in the on-time rate. **Stages**: time between the stage/development, stage/active and stage/freeze labels. **Time to green**: PR opened → first time every expected E2E suite had passed or been waived. **Test friction**: first test run after the release entered the active stage → all green, the part of time to green spent on getting the tests green rather than on assembling the release. **Merged with all suites green**: share of releases whose expected suites had all passed or been waived before the merge; suites that were not yet required when a PR was opened only count if they ran. **Runs until green**: test runs up to the all-green state. **Failure rate by suite**: failed runs of a suite divided by its failed plus passed runs, over the selected releases; every rerun on the same commit counts. **Last suite to go green**: the suite whose first pass or waiver came last on a release. Per-release charts are capped at 60 days, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Time per stage
panels.description: Days each release spent in the development, active and freeze stage, from the stage/* labels. Only releases that went through the stages (since February 2026). The axis is capped at 60 days, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Median time to green: major
panels.description: PR opened → first time every expected E2E suite had passed, major releases with per-suite results. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median time to green: minor
panels.description: PR opened → first time every expected E2E suite had passed, minor releases with per-suite results. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median test friction
panels.description: Test friction: first test run after the release entered the active stage → first time every expected suite had passed or been waived. Releases without stage labels use their first manual run. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Median runs until green
panels.description: Number of /run releases-test-suites comments up to the first all-green state, including the automated runs. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Time to green per release
panels.description: Days from PR opened to the first all-green test state (time to green), and the part of it after the first test run in the active stage (test friction). Only releases with per-suite results (since March 2026). The axis is capped at 60 days, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Test runs per release
panels.description: /run releases-test-suites comments per release PR, split into manual and automated (weekly bump, stage change) runs. The axis is capped at 100 runs, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Merged with all suites green
panels.description: Share of release PRs with per-suite results that had every expected E2E suite green or waived before the merge. 'releases' is the number of releases the value is computed from.

panels.title: Merged with all suites green per quarter
panels.description: Share of the release PRs merged in each quarter that had every expected E2E suite green or waived before the merge. Only releases with per-suite results (since March 2026). The current quarter is marked '(to date)' and still incomplete.

panels.title: Runs until green per release
panels.description: /run releases-test-suites comments up to the first all-green state, including the automated runs. Only releases that reached all green. The axis is capped at 100 runs, hover a clipped bar for its value.

panels.title: Failure rate by suite
panels.description: Failed runs divided by failed plus passed runs of each suite, over all selected releases. Cancelled and skipped runs are not counted. Hover for the runs, failures and releases behind the rate. Only releases with per-suite results (since March 2026); v35.0.0 is limited to its last 200 commits. A failure is whatever the suite run reported, infrastructure problems included.

panels.title: Last suite to go green
panels.description: Number of releases that waited for this suite last: its first pass or waiver set the release's all-green time. This is the suite that slowed the release down, whether or not it failed often. Only releases with per-suite results (since March 2026); v35.0.0 is limited to its last 200 commits. A failure is whatever the suite run reported, infrastructure problems included.

panels.title: Releases the suite failed on
panels.description: Share of the selected releases on which the suite failed at least once, so that one release with many retries does not dominate. Hover for the number of releases. Only releases with per-suite results (since March 2026); v35.0.0 is limited to its last 200 commits. A failure is whatever the suite run reported, infrastructure problems included.

panels.title: Suite results per release
panels.description: Every expected E2E suite of every release PR with per-suite results, with its completed check runs by outcome. 'failed' means at least one failed run, 'last to green' means the release waited for this suite last. This panel holds the embedded data for the suite panels; they read it from here.
